description: A Node.js service that enables task tracking and management through the Notion API, allowing programmatic creation and updating of tasks in a Notion database.

functional_requirements.description: System must create tasks in Notion database with title, assignment, status, and notes
System must update task status and notes for existing tasks
System must handle and log API errors gracefully
System must authenticate with Notion API using API key

non_functional_requirements.description: API credentials must be stored in environment variables
Code must be modular with exported functions for reusability

environment_variables.name: NOTION_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Notion integration API key for authentication

environment_variables.name: NOTION_DATABASE_ID
environment_variables.description: Target Notion database ID for task storage

Assigned To.description: Person or agent assigned to task

ambiguous_requirements_identified.description: Task assignment mechanism is unclear - 'Assigned To' field is set to empty array despite assignedTo parameter
ambiguous_requirements_identified.recommendation: Clarify if agent assignments should be stored as Notion people or use a different field type

ambiguous_requirements_identified.description: Status values limited to 'To-do' and 'Done' - no intermediate states like 'In Progress'
ambiguous_requirements_identified.recommendation: Document complete status workflow or extend available statuses

ambiguous_requirements_identified.description: No query/read functionality - only create and update operations exist
ambiguous_requirements_identified.recommendation: Clarify if task retrieval and listing capabilities are needed
